name: Fertility clinic

pf.license.need: a state physician license for each reproductive doctor, and the clinic's license where the state requires one; a nurse's license for injection teaching; the lab's certificate for any semen analysis the state names; the clinic's registration where the state's rules require it
pf.license.who: both: the clinic, and each clinician or nurse who sees patients
pf.license.ask: optional, for the owner's own page: each clinician's license number and the clinic's registration; nothing is needed to book
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up a license, certificate or training record; the owner keeps them current
pf.license.scope: a clinician sees only the kinds of care their license covers; a procedure is done only by the team the state names for it; Rosie never gives medical advice
pf.license.blocks: none from Rosie: no booking is held or refused because a license can't be read
pf.license.renewals: none kept by Rosie: the owner keeps the renewal dates
pf.license.insurance: the owner's own liability insurance; Rosie never verifies it
pf.license.background: the clinic's own background checks for staff who go into a patient's home, where its rules or the state require them; Rosie never verifies them
pf.license.telehealth: a video consult counts as at the clinic; the clinician's license for the patient's state applies

pf.services.shape: fertility clinic: consults and monitoring with a named doctor or the next open clinician; procedure days (an IUI, an egg retrieval or an embryo transfer) with the procedure team and a companion; a home nurse visit for injection teaching; a semen analysis dropped off in a private room at the clinic; a video consult counts as at the clinic
pf.services.examples: the example clinic's own prices and lengths, not a standard

list.name: New patient consult
list.price: billed to the health plan; self-pay from the clinic's price list (example: $220 self-pay)
list.after: the plan is billed; any share is billed after the plan pays
list.note: the first consult: a private history on the secure page only

list.name: Monitoring visit (scan and blood check)
list.note: monitoring mornings are set by the cycle plan the clinic gives; a visit is never named in a text

list.name: Semen analysis drop-off
list.note: a sample is checked in at once with the patient's two details; never named in a text

list.name: Hormone blood panel
list.note: the draw is booked with a monitoring visit where the plan allows

list.name: Video consult
list.price: $120 self-pay (example), paid in full when booking
list.where: by video (counts as at the clinic)
list.note: the code is read out at the start, as for any visit at the clinic

list.name: IUI procedure day
list.price: a deposit of $300 when booked (example), the rest billed by the clinic's own bill ($1,100 total, example)
list.after: the rest billed by the clinic's own bill
list.note: a companion drives the patient home; no companion, no procedure day (pf.visit.cantGoAhead)

list.name: IVF cycle (stimulation, retrieval, transfer)
list.price: a $12,000 cycle (example), a $3,000 deposit when booked and the rest billed by the clinic's bill
list.length: a series of visits and one procedure day
list.after: the rest billed by the clinic's own bill; never charged on a set day
list.note: donor and surrogacy matching are never booked by Rosie; the coordinator handles them

list.name: Injection teaching at home
list.price: billed to the plan its own way; $95 self-pay (example)
list.length: 40 min at the place; a 2-hour arrival window in the morning
list.before: nothing taken (the bill after), or a card saved
list.after: the clinic bills the plan its own way, or the bill is texted for a self-pay patient
list.note: a nurse teaches the patient's own injection; no medicine is given at home by Rosie's booking

pf.services.capacity: exam rooms and a procedure room at the clinic (example 3 rooms), each a 15-minute slot for a monitoring visit or 60 minutes for a consult; procedure days by the team's calendar; home visits by route, a set number each morning
pf.services.online: video consults only where the state allows them for that care; results are on the secure page
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the patient must be there
pf.services.walkIns: no walk-in line; a monitoring visit that is missed is rebooked from the clinic's own cycle plan

whether it's a video consult (counts as at the clinic)
a health plan or self-pay (only the plan's name here)
for a procedure day: the adult who will drive the patient home, named on the booking
for a home visit: the town and whether the patient can come to the door
afterTime: a note for the clinician: a past faint at a visit, or a hard blood draw
for a home visit: the address, parking and any gate code
securePage: the private history for a new patient (on the secure page only)
date of birth (every visit is matched to the patient by two details)
medicines that matter, only where the clinic asks
consent for a procedure, signed before the day
a partner's OK to join, on the secure page
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves (18 or older); a partner may join with the patient's own OK on the secure page; nobody under 18 is booked; donor and surrogacy matching is never booked by Rosie

stop.words: heavy bleeding, severe belly or pelvic pain, dizziness or fainting, trouble breathing, or chest pain, after a procedure or a stimulation medicine

goOn.words: mild cramping or bloating after a procedure
goOn.what: the booking goes on, with the soonest same-day time; the nurse line calls within the hour; never answered by Rosie

goOn.words: a question about a medicine or a result
goOn.what: never answered by Rosie: the clinic's nurse line; the clinician is told that day

goOn.words: feels unsafe at home or with a partner
goOn.what: the family-violence line's words come first, then the booking goes on privately; the team is told that day, with no detail in any text

pf.safety.fasting: none for these visits; a blood draw has its own prep from the clinic
pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency or self-harm → call 911 or 988, and no booking

steps.name: A private history for a new patient
steps.when: on the secure page before the first consult
steps.result: done: booked; not done: the desk asks once, then the consult waits

steps.name: Consent for a procedure
steps.when: signed on the secure page before the procedure day
steps.result: signed: booked; not signed: no procedure day

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: by the desk before the visit
steps.result: covered, part covered (the share shown), or not covered (self-pay); where the plan's rules require it, a notice of likely non-coverage is signed before the visit

steps.name: The procedure day's companion
steps.when: named on the booking, before the day
steps.result: named: booked; none: no procedure day

pf.first_steps.prep: for the reminder: photo ID, the plan card, a list of medicines, and any old records; for a procedure day: the companion's name and a plan for the ride home; for a home visit, clear the path to the room

pf.visit.checkIn: at the front desk: the code, then photo ID and the plan card checked against the secure page; a home visit: the code at the door, then photo ID
pf.visit.changes: the clinic adds a test or a monitoring visit: priced first, with the self-pay price shown; a procedure day waits for a written OK; nothing else is sold at a visit
pf.visit.cantGoAhead: no ID; a procedure day with no companion named (no procedure, no fee); bleeding that is an emergency (911 words first); the patient feels faint: the visit stops and a new visit is booked with no charge
pf.visit.done: the code, then DONE from the clinician; the bill is the clinic's; results go to the patient's secure page; Rosie keeps only booking records
pf.visit.rejected: a sample that can't be used: the patient is offered a new sample with no charge, by the secure page
pf.visit.dropOff: a semen sample is checked in at the desk at once with the patient's two details

pf.money.before: consults and monitoring visits take nothing when booking; a video consult is paid in full when booking; a procedure cycle takes a deposit when booking; a card may be saved for a no-show fee only if the owner turns it on
pf.money.insurance: health plans: only the plan's name before times; member details on the secure page; the clinic bills the plan; the patient's share is billed after the plan pays (Rosie texts the bill)
pf.money.thirdParty: none: an employer or a family member is never the payer through Rosie
pf.money.estimate: a self-pay patient gets a written price estimate before a procedure cycle, where the rules require it
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form
pf.money.fees: a cycle's cancel fee (example $250) is never more than what was paid as the deposit; a no-show fee (example $150) only with a saved card and never for a fee-free patient
pf.money.refunds: the owner decides refunds; Rosie never refunds on its own

pf.messages.never: the history, the names of tests or procedures, cycle or pregnancy details, results, medicines, ID numbers and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the clinic's name, the day, the time and the place
pf.messages.staffTexts: the owner and staff get the patient's initials, the time and the room; no health details
pf.messages.results: a text says only 'your results are ready on the secure page'
pf.messages.minors: no patient under 18: nobody under 18 is booked

pf.staff.licenses: each doctor holds a state physician license; each nurse holds a nursing license; the clinic keeps its own record (optional, never looked up by Rosie)
pf.staff.skills: reproductive medicine, monitoring, IUI and retrieval support, embryology, semen analysis, injection teaching, counseling referral, Spanish
pf.staff.supervision: the clinic's medical director; a new nurse or clinician works under a senior one until signed off
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs new patients, procedure prices and refunds
pf.staff.standIn: a patient may ask for a named doctor; the next open clinician with the skill takes it otherwise; a procedure day stays with its named team, and is never moved to a stand-in without the patient's OK
pf.staff.away: only nurses cleared for home visits go to a patient's home

pf.rules.privacy: a health privacy agreement (a business associate agreement) is signed before going live; health details only on the secure page
pf.rules.records: medical and lab records are the clinic's own, kept as long as the state's rules require; Rosie keeps only booking records
pf.rules.consent: adults only; a partner may join with the patient's own OK; a procedure needs the patient's own consent on the secure page; donor and surrogacy matching are never booked by Rosie
pf.rules.showFacts: the clinic's name and address; no license claim unless the owner gives it as the owner's own word
pf.rules.results: results go to the patient's secure page within the time the health privacy rules set
pf.rules.reviews: a rating is never asked for health work (sensitive); any reply never confirms the person was a patient

pf.edges.noOrder: a referral the plan needs: the desk asks the plan while the patient waits, or the visit moves with no fee
pf.edges.rejected: a sample that can't be used: a free new sample
pf.edges.critical: a result that needs same-day care: the clinician calls the patient, never a text
pf.edges.faint: a patient feels faint at a visit: the visit stops, the patient lies down, 911 if hurt; the owner is told with no health detail
pf.edges.mobile: a homebound patient doesn't come to the door: the nurse calls, then the contact on the booking; the owner decides a welfare check; no fee while the patient's safety is unknown
pf.edges.results: results to the patient; never to the payer
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
